output.title: Aerobic Foundation Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min walking and light mobility drills → 30 min continuous easy running @ Zone 2 heart rate below 148 bpm → Cool down 5 min walking. Overall: Gentle continuous aerobic run to inaugurate the training block with zero anaerobic debt. Maintains steady conversational pace throughout on flat ground. Reason: Initiates routine consistency and expands capillary bed density without structural distress. Benefit: Elevates aerobic mitochondrial volume and improves foundational cardiac stroke volume. Warning: Strictly avoid pushing into Zone 3; back off immediately to a walk if heart rate climbs above 148 bpm.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: General Bodyweight Resilience
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min dynamic mobility and hip openers → Bodyweight Squats: 3x12, 90s rest → Reverse Lunges: 3x10 each leg, 90s rest → Step-ups on bench: 3x10 each leg, 90s rest → Standing Calf Raises: 3x15, 60s rest → Forearm Plank: 3x30s hold, 60s rest → Cool down 5 min full-body stretching. Overall: Foundational bodyweight strength routine focused strictly on movement quality, joint conditioning, and pelvic stability. Performed with zero external resistance to protect soft tissues. Reason: Establishes prerequisite eccentric quad control and ankle integrity required for future mountain trail loading. Benefit: Strengthens kinetic chain connective tissues and builds resistance against repetitive impact fatigue. Warning: Maintain flawless knee-over-toe alignment; stop any set early if technical movement degrades.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Rest and Tissue Restoration
output.description: Process: Rest day with zero structured physical exertion → Optional 10 min gentle breathing exercises or foam rolling. Overall: Dedicated full recovery day to absorb initial training stimuli and facilitate physiological adaptation. Keeps autonomic stress low. Reason: Prevents premature fatigue accumulation and preserves muscular freshness for the weekend aerobic sessions. Benefit: Enables complete glycogen synthesis and connective tissue collagen remodeling. Warning: Resist the temptation to perform unplanned cross-training or supplementary runs.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Flat Aerobic Base Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min brisk walk → 35 min steady aerobic running @ Zone 2 → Cool down 5 min walking. Overall: Relaxed flat run focusing on rhythm, tall posture, and controlled nose-and-mouth breathing. Solidifies aerobic discipline. Reason: Promotes base endurance volume without exceeding novice recovery bandwidth. Benefit: Stimulates slow-twitch muscle fiber recruitment and oxidative enzyme production. Warning: Do not surge on slight road rises; keep breathing effortlessly conversational.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Introductory Long Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min easy walking → 55 min continuous steady aerobic long run @ Zone 2 → Cool down 5 min walking and lower body stretches. Overall: Longest endurance outing of the initial block, capped safely within weekly volume proportionality guidelines. Trains mental endurance and structural resilience. Reason: Stimulates lipid metabolism and cellular endurance capacity without over-stressing musculoskeletal structures. Benefit: Expands intra-muscular glycogen storage efficiency and enhances lower-limb tendon elasticity. Warning: Avoid starting fast; ensure pace is sustainable for the entire duration with heart rate remaining strictly below 148 bpm.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.
